en: Every milestone the plan holds is listed, in the graph's order, and none is left out for a field a person did or did not fill in. A milestone that has shipped shows the release that carried it: the first release record containing its last accepted issue, inferred from the records and never typed; one no release has carried yet reads <t1>unreleased</t1>. Under it are its issues, grouped by their declared status, each linking to its own page. Each milestone names the claim it would move out of <t2>planned</t2>. Naming it is not promoting it: a claim becomes <t3>guaranteed</t3> when an implementation, a behavioural test and a blocking CI job exist for it, and the guarantees matrix will keep saying <t4>planned</t4> until they do.
cs: Je uveden každý milník, který plán obsahuje, v pořadí grafu, a žádný není vynechán kvůli poli, které někdo vyplnil či nevyplnil.
